embeds.title: ADD THE LEAGUE CALENDAR TO YOUR PHONE
embeds.description: Every PSBL date can live in the calendar you already use.

fields.name: HOW
fields.value: Type `/link` in any channel. Sesh replies privately with a calendar feed link.

fields.name: THEN
fields.value: Add that link to Google Calendar (Other calendars → From URL), Apple Calendar (File → New Calendar Subscription) or Outlook (Add calendar → From internet).

fields.name: WHAT YOU GET
fields.value: Draft night, deadlines and owners' meetings appear on your phone and update on their own when a date changes.
